records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;

records.sql:

       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,

records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit) / SUM(i.sales) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL AND i.sales <> 0
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY margin_pct ASC

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
       AVG(sales) AS median_sales,
       MIN(sales) AS min_sales,
       MAX(sales) AS max_sales,
       AVG(sales) AS mean_sales
FROM (
  SELECT sales,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM order_items
  WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)

       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS profit,
